title: Q1 2026 Perf Baseline — Run Tracker (models x regions x SKUs)
linked_artifacts: Confluence ADR-0172: Benchmark metrics + run-manifest format
Confluence ADR-0173: Workload sourcing from prod telemetry
content:
Notes / how to use this sheet
- Purpose: single tracker of baseline sweeps (Q1 2026) across model x region x GPU SKU x workload. This is the source of truth for what is “done”, where artifacts live, and whether a run is acceptable for the frozen baseline.
- Baseline anchor build (runtime): redwood-runtime tag: runtime-2026.01.19+baseline (git: 8f3c1b7) — confirmed in Slack thread 1764107317
- Canonical metrics definitions: TTFT = first-token-on-wire at server boundary; TPOT = server-side time-per-output-token excluding client read time. See ADR-0172 and Slack thread 1763261084.
- Caching: we report BOTH cold and warm scenarios per decision in Slack thread 1764196509.
- Artifact conventions:
  - manifest.json: canonical run manifest (schema v1.2)
  - results.jsonl: per-request metrics export
  - summary.csv: rollup (p50/p95/p99 + CI bands)
  - traces/: Nsight Systems timeline + scheduler logs (where collected)

Conditional formatting (implemented in the real sheet)
- Status cell:
  - Green = COMPLETE
  - Yellow = IN_REVIEW
  - Gray = BLOCKED
- Regression vs baseline:
  - PASS (green): within noise band OR improved
  - WARN (amber): > threshold_warn but < threshold_fail on any primary metric (TTFT p95/p99, TPOT p95, throughput)
  - FAIL (red): >= threshold_fail on any primary metric OR kernel fallback not allowed for baseline
- Current thresholds (draft; subject to Sana/Claire signoff):
  - TTFT p99: WARN +3.0% / FAIL +6.0%
  - TPOT p95: WARN +2.0% / FAIL +4.0%
  - Throughput tokens/s: WARN -3.0% / FAIL -6.0%
  - Sample size minimum: 800 req (chat/tool), 500 req (long_prefill), 5 min steady-state (embeddings)
